releaseNotes:
1. Strict 29 Master Feeders: Fixed feeder dropdowns across Pre-monsoon, Routine Patrol, and Special Work to strictly load the 29 master feeders (1-29) without extra/duplicate entries in Tamil and English.
2. Right Drawer Feeder Name Wrapping: Feeder names calculate line length and wrap naturally after the hyphen (' - ') without shrinking text size, keeping font crisp and readable.
3. Dynamic Language Updates: Dropdowns and drawer items instantly re-render when switching between English ('EN') and Tamil ('த').
4. Robust Record Filtering: Database queries for saved inspections, patrols, and special works match records across both English and Tamil feeder aliases.
